failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1 reasoning, the solver states about Justin Miller: 'He was subsequently re-acquired by the Jets in 2009 after playing for the Oakland Raiders.' However, the passage says Miller 'played for the Jets from 2005 to 2008, the Oakland Raiders from 2008 to 2009, the Jets again in 2009' — meaning he rejoined during 2009, not that he was re-acquired after fully completing his Raiders tenure in 2009. The solver also states Justin Miller 'played for them through 2007-2008' in hop 2 summary, when the passage clearly states '2005 to 2008' (four seasons, not two).

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: The claim requires verification of an athlete 're-acquired in the 2015 New York Jets season.' Both solver summaries acknowledge the missing 2015 re-acquisition evidence (hop 1: 'passages do not mention a 2015 re-acquisition'; hop 2: 'passages do not support the claim that he was re-acquired by the Jets in 2015'), but neither summary names a specific entity or player to retrieve. The summaries only state what is missing generically without specifying which athlete should be searched for in relation to 2015.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Which NFL athlete was drafted by the New York Jets, played for them starting two years after their draft year, and was specifically re-acquired by the Jets during the 2015 season?' This is a natural-language yes/no question format with multiple bundled criteria rather than entity-focused keywords the retriever can target effectively.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: The claim states the athlete 'played for The New York Jets, two years after he was drafted. He was re-acquired in the 2015 New York Jets season.' Hop 3 retrieval returned multiple passages showing players drafted by the Jets in 2013 who would play starting in 2015 (two years later): Bryce Petty, Deon Simon, Lorenzo Mauldin all 'drafted by the Jets in...2015 NFL Draft'. However, these were drafted IN 2015, not re-acquired. More critically, the Kris Jenkins passage (hop 1) states he 'was traded to the New York Jets in 2008' after being 'drafted by the Panthers in...2001' — he played for the Jets starting two years after 2001 (2003) while with Panthers, then was acquired by Jets in 2008. The solver focused exclusively on Justin Miller and never considered whether other retrieved passages matched the claim structure.
